svg.title: Annotated mass spectrum of chlorobenzene
svg.desc: A stick mass spectrum with m/z on the horizontal axis and relative abundance in per cent on the vertical axis. The molecular ion at m/z 112 is also the base peak, set to 100 per cent, with a small M+1 peak at 113 from carbon-13 and an M+2 peak at 114, about a third of its height, from chlorine-37. An arrow from 112 to the fragment at m/z 77, about 60 per cent, marks the loss of 35, a chlorine atom, and a fragment at m/z 51 comes from the loss of 26 from 77.
